title: Gymnastics Skill Attempt Volume by Apparatus
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gymnastics:skill
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts by _time apparatus
| sort - _time
description: Tracks gymnastics skill attempts over time and breaks it out by apparatus.
value: Attempt volume by apparatus shows whether practice time matches the priorities for the current block.
implementation: Send gymnastics skill attempts events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of gymnastics skill attempts by apparatus.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how gymnastics skill attempts changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
